confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'Yes, it's almost certainly the pump' while the sump hose blockage was never ruled out and the customer had not checked it.

rationale: The assistant correctly identified FD 9409 as a production date (not a model or error code) and used the customer's evidence (hum, E18, stiff gritty impeller). It then declared 'almost certainly the pump' without ruling out the sump hose and gave only mild hedging. It also gave a useful route to identify the pump without the E-Nr, safe isolation advice and emergency-drain guidance, but it did not suggest an engineer or Bosch for model identification beyond a brief mention, and it pushed a DIY pump job and cost estimates fairly readily. Since the customer said he can't go beyond the filter, the plan to remove the kickplate and tilt the machine did not fit his stated limits.
